_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md)

pit_profile.why: Accenture: #1-scale IT-services and consulting franchise that took share through the cloud cycle; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not

classification.quality_note: Accenture: #1-scale IT-services and consulting franchise that took share through the cloud cycle; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 1.01x; +42% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.58; conservative 2yr +6%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY12-FY22, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +13.8%/yr (latest guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +13.8%/yr (FY12-FY22 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +16.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY12-FY22); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2022-11-18) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 1.01x (31.9% downside to Bear $195 / +31.6% upside to Bull $377) | Adj composite 3.58 vs market 3.00: gap +0.58 [UNDERVALUED] | +41% above the EPP floor $202 (18x FY23E $11.25) | Conservative 2-yr case: +6.3% total (+3.1%/yr) | At 25.5x FY23E the 15% hurdle price $379 sits above the BULL case; consulting +22% LC in Q4, Q1 guided +10-14% LC; no disruption theme has dated evidence.
